shared_elements: schematic creature with a head shown in profile-ish view
eye rendered as a small circle/dot
design fitted to a rounded, irregular surface
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic creature imagery with distinguishable heads and simple round eyes fitted to an irregular rounded surface, but that is about as generic as figural decoration gets. A shows a single large, rounded, sculpturally modelled body in relief with a comb-like element, while B shows multiple interlocking, spiky, angular serpentine bodies drawn as continuous outlines repeated across the whole field — different creature forms, different multiplicity, and different drawing conventions.
